Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
If two vampires have the same innate ability (eg : Jojo can bleed your
predator as a D action ; and : Juju can bleed your predator as a D action)
can a vampire mask the action done by the other ? or is still considered
illegal ?

(and , yes, i have something in mind)

reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
>
> If two vampires have the same innate ability (eg : Jojo can bleed your
> predator as a D action ; and : Juju can bleed your predator as a D action)
> can a vampire mask the action done by the other ?

No. Each action by card in play is a different action.

Archon is not a card in play, so the Archon action is not restricted
like a card in play action.

A second Archon (with obf) can mask the Archon rush action taken by the
first Archon.

Nice... Out of curiosity... Was an archon ever not allowed to do this? I
find this reference to card in play in the old rules too...

"If a card in play is used to perform one of these actions, that action is
considered to be of that type. If it is not one of these actions (such as
"enter combat via Haven Uncovered"), then it is a type of its own, by
specific instance of the card in play."

/Henrik Isaksson

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henrik Isaksson wrote:
> Nice... Out of curiosity... Was an archon ever not allowed to do this? I
> find this reference to card in play in the old rules too...
>
> "If a card in play is used to perform one of these actions, that action is
> considered to be of that type. If it is not one of these actions (such as
> "enter combat via Haven Uncovered"), then it is a type of its own, by
> specific instance of the card in play."

Well, probably most judges/players would've counted it as a card in play,
but no, it isn't restricted by the current VEKN Special Floor rule, since
it (the Archon rush) is not an action card nor an action granted by a
card in play.


